clips.title: The story
paras: In the northern cliffs of the Valley of Trials, the Burning Blade Coven threatens the Horde’s newest recruits. Corrupted cultists and summoned demons haunt the old mineral caves, using them as a staging ground for dark magic on Durotar’s doorstep.

Dark rituals now trouble the caves along the Valley of Trials’ northern edge. Imps and lesser fiends spill from the cavern mouth, stirring chaos and threatening the young orcs and Darkspear trolls who train here for service to the Horde. The Burning Blade cult has entrenched itself deep inside, led by the shadowy warlock Yarrog Baneshadow. What was a testing wilderness is now an active battleground against demonic corruption.

Before demons took root in the caves, local overseers hoped to harvest their raw materials for the settlement. Foreman Thazz'ril ventured inside on a mineral survey, but the cultists drove him out in haste, and he left valuable equipment behind. Driving back Baneshadow's coven is now the ultimate proving trial for aspiring warriors, rogues, and spellcasters before they are deemed ready to venture into greater Durotar.
